verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents its own log streaming service, which exports tenant logs to a log analysis service in near real-time, with a configurable content type and format and a payload preview in the Dashboard. That covers the stream-to-SIEM half of the story. The evidence does not show tamper-evidence (integrity or immutability guarantees), does not say the tenant logs cover admin activity as well as authentication events, and names no SIEM destinations. missing for 10: tamper-evident or integrity-protected logs, explicit coverage of admin and authentication event types, named SIEM integrations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
